completion_truth: SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS are active and incomplete. PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired with no remaining product work or active execution domain. PROGRAMMING is an incomplete active non-peer work program.
startup_sequence: Read this file from current main.
Read last_sealed_state_checkpoint as the latest coherent checkpoint, but always re-fetch live active-owner heads before execution.
Read selected topology, program_job_lock and system_completion_status before completion, ownership or work-selection claims.

Read selected completion_ledger, obligation_registry, expectation_registry, reallocation_ledger and system_catalog. Older selected-prior records are historical evidence only when they conflict with this authority.

Active peers are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. PROSE is complete and terminally retired and is not an active child, inherited execution route, repair lane, qualification lane, research task, telemetry lane, successor task or claim domain.
Any metadata that still labels PROSE active is STALE_ARCHITECTURE_PENDING_RECONCILIATION and cannot dispatch. Historical exact Prose evidence remains immutable provenance.

BOOK owns any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability through Book-owned adapters/context/compiler/routing/orchestration and retains sole canonical Book/manuscript/Story-Bible/author/lifecycle/admission/versioning/publication authority.
DOCUMENTS receives no Prose work. Documents remains the peer document/artifact system and may expose only explicit generic document services to Book/System Master.
LEARNING finishes Learning and integrates upward into System Master without crossing Book, Documents or Programming product work.
CORE finishes shared Foundation/Spine/integration infrastructure without taking peer or Programming engineering semantics.

While SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 is selected, CORE prioritizes Programming proving-corpus recovery first and remaining authorized catalog/archive recovery second as the highest discretionary System Master work after non-discretionary safety/control integrity.

PROGRAMMING continues as a named active non-peer engineering work program from preserved evidence. Knowledge Recovery supports source/custody/provenance but does not replace Programming engineering or create a Programming peer lane.

Second Shift compares topology peer_system_ids with registry owner_files on every run. Machine-resolvable missing coverage is provisioned only for an already-declared peer; missing coverage never creates a system and retired systems are never provisioned.
Require exactly one mutation-capable claim at most per active peer lane. PROSE has no claim domain. Overlap or stale head binding fails closed and must be reconciled before mutation.

Telemetry is factual and only for CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. Missing ledgers are UNKNOWN, not inferred. No new Prose telemetry is created or expected; Book integration using preserved completed Prose capability is BOOK telemetry only.

Repair routing is CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS only. A failure in current Book-owned integration around preserved completed Prose capability is a BOOK repair subject; historical Prose does not reopen a repair lane.
If Programming is requested, read programming_work_program_lock and programming_system_packet before broad rediscovery or implementation selection.
Require enforcement to execute on the relevant exact current subject before calling it semantically green. Zero-step hosted attempts are infrastructure-only and are neither PASS nor FAIL.

Before ending substantive work, re-read live authority/head state, reconcile affected obligation/delegation/repair state and bind one exact dependency-valid successor inside the same active system or named work-program job. Never bind a Prose successor.

truth_classes.AUTHORITY_CURRENT: Live active-owner state, current topology/job/completion/retirement locks and evidence agree.
truth_classes.AUTHORITY_DELTA: Live owner state moved after the current selector; reconcile only the delta.
truth_classes.STALE_ARCHITECTURE_PENDING_RECONCILIATIO: Metadata conflicts with CURRENT-AUTHORITY-003, including any current-dispatch claim that PROSE is active, inherited or owned by Documents.
truth_classes.RETIRED_SYSTEM_RESURRECTION: Work attempts to create, dispatch, repair, qualify, research, telemeter, auto-provision or bind a successor for terminally retired PROSE.
truth_classes.JOB_LANE_VIOLATION: Work attempts to take another active system or named work program's product job or semantic authority outside an admitted interface.
truth_classes.FALSE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION: A phase, packet, test, branch or subsystem closure is used to claim completion of SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK or DOCUMENTS.
truth_classes.PROGRAMMING_SCOPE_DRIFT: Programming work is restarted, absorbed into another lane, used to take another system's semantics or treated as a peer system without explicit admission.
truth_classes.STALE_DELEGATION: Second Shift delegation does not match live owner head, current obligation, topology/job/completion/retirement locks or active peer coverage.
truth_classes.OVERLAPPING_MUTATION_CLAIM: More than one mutation-capable claim is live in the same active peer lane.
truth_classes.EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Claimed standing exceeds exact subject/receipt/artifact evidence.
truth_classes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Machine-readable authority cannot select among valid product choices.
truth_classes.AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Progress requires author authority automation cannot synthesize.
truth_classes.PRIVATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires private data authority not granted.
truth_classes.NATIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires native device/platform evidence not available.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires external provider/publication/certification authority not granted by repository evidence.

write_rules: Historical evidence and exact-SHA receipts remain append-only.
PROSE may be described only as historically complete and terminally retired for current execution. It cannot be described as an active child or current owner.
CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain in their own active product lanes and integrate upward through System Master/shared interfaces without ownership transfer.
BOOK is the only owner of any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability; DOCUMENTS receives none of that work.
PROGRAMMING remains a distinct active work program with preserved engineering semantics/evidence continuity and is not a peer until explicit admission.
Knowledge Recovery 001 remains highest discretionary System Master priority while selected and may not create topology or replace Programming engineering.
Changed integration/control subjects require fresh evidence; no PASS transfers across changed SHA, topology, subject or ownership boundaries.
Auto-provisioning can fill missing execution coverage for an already-declared active peer only when machine-resolvable; it cannot create a system or resurrect a retired system.
